annotations.title: Convert a time between time zones

description: Convert a date and time from one IANA time zone to another, applying the daylight-saving rules in force on that date in each zone. Returns the local time, UTC offset and weekday in both zones and the UTC instant. Flags local times that occur twice or not at all around a clock change. Use it for meeting times and scheduling across regions — offsets change through the year and differ by hemisphere.

datetime.description: Local date and time in the source zone, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (seconds optional). If it ends in Z or an offset such as +05:30 it is taken as an exact instant and from_zone is ignored.

from_zone.description: IANA zone the datetime is in, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.

to_zone.description: IANA zone to convert to, e.g. Asia/Tokyo.

name: timezone_convert
title: Convert a time between time zones
